purpose: Record the missing bridge from named QFT-side geometric observables and a scaling-limit procedure to controlled convergence toward a metric-like candidate, without asserting convergence or metric construction.

missing_bridge.name: GeometricObservableConvergenceObligation
missing_bridge.weakest_missing_object: a controlled convergence estimate for QFT-side geometric observables under an explicit scaling-limit procedure, with covariance, stability, and approximation-error obligations separated from metric construction and Einstein-limit recovery
sub_obligations: define the geometric observables extracted from QFT-side source data
define the topology or norm in which convergence is measured
state the scaling regime and approximation parameters
prove or bound convergence of the observables in that regime
record that emergent metric construction and Einstein-limit recovery remain separate later obligations
